requirementSets.name: BPP Works — Standard
requirementSets.description: Mandatory eligibility and technical requirements for open competitive bidding on works contracts.

requirementSets.name: PPA 2007 — Eligibility Core
requirementSets.description: Statutory eligibility criteria every bidder must satisfy under the Act.

requirements.title: Certificate of Incorporation (CAC)
requirements.text: Evidence of registration with the Corporate Affairs Commission — certificate of incorporation or registration of business name.

requirements.title: Tax Clearance Certificate — last 3 years
requirements.text: Current tax clearance certificate for the three years immediately preceding the bid (2023, 2024, 2025), expiring 31 December of the current year.

requirements.title: PENCOM Compliance Certificate
requirements.text: Valid pension clearance certificate showing remittance of employee pension contributions.

requirements.title: ITF Compliance Certificate
requirements.text: Valid Industrial Training Fund compliance certificate.

requirements.title: NSITF Compliance Certificate
requirements.text: Valid Nigeria Social Insurance Trust Fund clearance certificate.

requirements.title: BPP Interim Registration Report (IRR)
requirements.text: Evidence of registration on the National Database of Federal Contractors, Consultants and Service Providers.

requirements.title: Audited Financial Statements — last 3 years
requirements.text: Audited accounts for the last three financial years, signed by a licensed auditor, demonstrating financial capacity.

requirements.title: Average Annual Turnover ≥ ₦250m
requirements.text: Minimum average annual construction turnover of ₦250 million within the last three years.

requirements.title: Similar Projects — 2 in last 5 years
requirements.text: Evidence of at least two contracts of similar nature and complexity, each ≥ ₦150 million, completed within the last five years, with award letters and completion certificates.

requirements.title: Key Personnel — Project Manager (COREN)
requirements.text: CV and certificates of a project manager with COREN registration and ≥ 10 years' relevant experience.

requirements.title: Equipment Schedule with Proof of Ownership
requirements.text: Schedule of essential equipment (concrete mixers, tippers, excavator, water tanker) with proof of ownership or lease agreement.

requirements.title: Sworn Affidavit of Non-Debarment
requirements.text: Sworn affidavit disclosing that the company is not in receivership, has no director convicted of financial crime, and is not debarred from public procurement.

evaluations.project: Rehabilitation of Bida–Lemu Road, Section II

results.justification: Certificate of incorporation RC 482291 issued 14 March 2008 in the name of Zenith Bond Construction Ltd matches the bidding entity exactly.
TCC covers assessment years 2023–2025 and shows expiry of 31/12/2026; taxpayer name and TIN are consistent with the CAC record.
Pension clearance certificate valid to 31/12/2026; certificate number verified format PEN/CC/2026 series.
ITF certificate current for 2026 and issued to the bidding entity.
No NSITF clearance certificate was found in any submitted document. This is a mandatory requirement under the Employees' Compensation Act 2010.
IRR number on the company profile matches the BPP contractor-database format and is dated within validity.
Audited statements for FY2023–FY2025 signed by Adekunle & Co (FRC/2013/ICAN/00000001234).
Computed average annual construction turnover is ₦243m — within 3% of the ₦250m threshold. Restated 2024 figures make the calculation ambiguous; recommend committee verification.
Two road contracts (₦310m FERMA 2022; ₦185m NSMW 2024) with award letters and completion certificates attached.
Proposed PM holds COREN reg. R.12,345 with 14 years' road-construction experience; certificates attached.
Schedule lists all required plant; ownership receipts for mixer and tippers, lease agreement for excavator included.
No sworn affidavit of non-debarment was found. PPA 2007 s.16(6)(f) makes this mandatory; its absence is grounds for rejection.
